subject: Third-party dependency pedigree and ownership assertion request
messages:
From: Alice Noble <alice.noble@mediform.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@mediform.com
Date: 2026-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Third-party dependency pedigree and SOC 2 assertions — request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this — Mediform's procurement and security teams are running a supplier assurance review as part of our upcoming pilot procurement. We need a concise pedigree of Redwood's external dependencies and clarity on which vendors are in-scope for SOC 2 responsibility and which are covered by downstream attestations. Specifically could you provide:

- A current subprocessor roster with locations (country) and role (hosting, telemetry, KMS, analytics).
- A short mapping that indicates which dependencies are onshore vs. offshore and the custody model for keys (Redwood-managed KMS, subprocessor KMS, customer-managed).
- Any CAIQ/SIG pointers or SOC 2 artifact locations we can reference (summary + link or attached doc).

We're on a tight timeline: procurement would like an initial package by EOD Wednesday (2026-09-09). If there's any part that requires legal or engineering input, please loop them in.

Appreciate it — I can also set up a 30-min follow-up if that helps.

Best,
Alice Noble
Security Program Manager
Mediform Health
[attachment: mediform_security_qna.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Noble <alice.noble@mediform.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party dependency pedigree and SOC 2 assertions — request

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a short roster and a one-page pedigree summary to start. High level notes below: 

- Subprocessors: attached CSV lists names, primary country of operation, primary role, and whether they are in-scope for Redwood's SOC 2 controls. We call out any transitively subcontracted services in the "notes" column.
- Key custody: Redwood uses customer-kms for Private deployments when requested. For hosted service customers, primary crypto functions are in Redwood-managed KMS (AWS KMS in us-west-2) and certain encryption envelopes use a third-party HSM provider (onshore partner). See pedigree PDF for mapping.
- OSS / runtime deps: runtime OSS libs and model-serving components are listed in the pedigree PDF; we flag any high-risk transitive native modules.
- Artifacts: we don't attach full SOC 2 reports here. Documented pointers are in the pedigree PDF and a link to our compliance drive is below. For your procurement review, we can provide a SOC 2 summary letter and a scoped CAIQ compact upon NDA.

Next steps/action items:
1) I'll confirm KMS residency and HSM partner contract excerpt with Ben and Jonas (cc'd).
2) Ben will pull the most recent subcontractor residency table for onshore-only filter.
3) If you need the SOC 2 bridge letter, we can prepare a draft for signature — timeline 3 business days post-NDA.

Attachments:
- redwood_subprocessors_20260905.csv (csv)
- thirdparty-pedigree-summary-20260905.pdf (pdf)

If useful, happy to do a quick walkthrough (20–30 min) early next week. 

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_subprocessors_20260905.csv (csv)]
[attachment: thirdparty-pedigree-summary-20260905.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party dependency pedigree and SOC 2 assertions — request

Looping in Jonas to validate the KMS/HSM custody notes in the pedigree PDF. Quick clarifications from infra side: 

- HSM partner is an onshore vendor (contracted for key wrapping); I'll attach the contract excerpt if Marissa wants it included in the procurement packet.
- For hosted-tier customers: sensitive token encryption is envelope-wrapped in Redwood-managed KMS. For Dedicated/Private tiers we offer customer-managed KMS (instructions in the Private onboarding guide).
- Items for action: Jonas, can you confirm (by EOD 2026-09-07) the list of subprocessors that are physically located within EU/US versus APAC, and call out any that have cross-border telemetry flows? Also flag anything with TPRM notes.

Thanks — once Jonas confirms I'll send an onshore-filtered CSV back to Alice and propose the SOC 2 summary letter draft.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: kms-hsm-excerpt-20260906.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alice Noble <alice.noble@mediform.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@mediform.com; procurement@mediform.com
Date: 2026-09-07T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party dependency pedigree and SOC 2 assertions — request

Marissa / Ben — this is helpful, thank you. We'll review the roster and pedigree doc with procurement tomorrow. A couple of quick asks so we can close our procurement gate: 

- Can you provide an estimated ETA for the SOC 2 summary letter (you noted ~3 business days after NDA)? Procurement needs that estimate to schedule the legal review.
- If you can supply the onshore-filtered CSV and the HSM contract excerpt, that would address most of our remaining gating items.

If everything looks good we may not need a walkthrough, but I'll confirm after the internal review.

Best,
Alice
Security Program Manager
Mediform Health
[attachment: mediform_security_qna.pdf (pdf)]
